name: 64120 · Kansas City, MO
findings: ZIP 64120 (Kansas City) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64120 (Kansas City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 64120 (Kansas City) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.0 times the typical level).
